quest.title: Path of the Taishou
quest.description: This storm has passed. You and Paimon prepare to visit Shiki Taishou again to see how the Mystic Onmyou Chamber is doing...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I explained the situation to the Tenryou Commission and showed them the original documentation. In the end, they believed that the Mystic Onmyou Chamber and I were innocent.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awesome! Does that mean you can start to focus on your original assignment again?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: That's right. I've also restored the Mystic Onmyou Chamber to its original state — a domain dedicated to honing martial prowess.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: With time, this Domain may exhaust itself of charm magic. When that time comes, I will let it lie dormant so that power can gradually reaccumulate.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Now might be a good time to give it a try. Are you up for the challenge?
